races.display_title: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Fillies Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict: Preference is for RIVER TRIEUX , who bumped into a useful prospect at Cork second time up and Paddy Twomey's filly can leave her subsequent Fairyhouse effort behind dropped into claiming company. Joseph O'Brien saddles a couple and his recent C&D winner Eleanor Shelby rates as the main threat. Purely and Near Perfection can fight out third. RIVER TRIEUX ELEANOR SHELBY PURELY (IRE)

races.verdict: INTERVENTION ran his best race for some time and looked unlucky not to finish closer in the process when third at Beverley 2 starts ago and, with his latest Ripon run best overlooked, Mick Appleby's 3-time C&D winner is too well handicapped to ignore back on all-weather. Methgal has been a model of consistency since joining Dylan Cunha and is an obvious threat. Willolarupi and Cayman Tai are others to consider. INTERVENTION METHGAL (IRE) WILLOLARUPI (IRE)
